PATIENT'S CHART: Prepares chart for admits. Prepares chart packets for unit use. Maintains chart in proper, complete order. Adds forms, as required. Places reports on charts. Reviews chart for signatures and completeness. Reviews orders for completion. Returns complete charts to medical records within 24 hours of patients discharge. Prepares chart and all thinned parts of chart to accompany patient for all internal transfers.
